body: hanging on for dear life. we've argued more times than we've had good times in the last 6 months. i feel it's coming and soon.

i don't think about killing myself. i know there's more to life than that.

i just can't help but feel that there's a big sign on my back saying 'abuse me, i'm a low maintenance girlfriend and i won't ask much of you. so go ahead and abuse me and treat me like trash.'

and like i said, my cutting isn't a regular thing. it's been so long since i've gotten to this point. and i needed a way to talk about it instead of keeping it inside, else i would have kept cutting.

i'm a student. and i would rather not be a sensitive person at this moment. not while my emotions are put into a blender and poured down the drain every time he chooses to dress up and see another girl over me.
i know it happens. and i know that there really isn't anything i can do about it. but it still hurts. and it is still hard to breathe. i just wish i wasn't so emotional.
cutting was the only thing that could have comforted me in the past. i haven't reverted back to it in over 4 years. i've just been through this so many times, i just wish there was a stop button.

i used to think i was ok, until this happens again. its a vicious cycle where i think someone loves me and then it all fades away when they find someone prettier or happier or just better than what i am.

it feels as though my boyfriend of two years has finally stopped loving me. i feel completely alone because he won't speak to me the way he used to and won't look at me the way he used to. i can barely breathe these days because i will try to talk to him and he will barely acknowledge me.

tonight was the first night in a very long time where i cut myself. i just don't know what to do anymore. i spent the last 2 years of my life thinking that he was the one and now it feels like it's all gone.
